text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data that includes both input and correct output. The computer uses this data to build a model. Once the model is trained, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of the model is measured by accuracy, which shows how often its predictions are correct. Generally, more training data leads to better accuracy.
